name: calendar.add_event
precondition: OAuth credentials are configured and the refresh token carries the calendar.events scope (run gates/_calendar_oauth_setup.py --scope 'calendar.readonly calendar.events'); summary is a non-empty string; start and end are valid RFC 3339 datetime strings with end after start.
postcondition: Creates an event on the primary calendar with the given summary, start time, and end time; returns structural metadata of the created event.
failure_mode: PreconditionError for invalid parameters (empty summary, invalid datetime, end not after start); PrimitiveError on auth/API failure.
